title: Page Lifecycle in bfcache
description: Observe JS heap freezing and lifecycle events emitted during Back navigation.

steps.label: 1. Outbound Navigation (pagehide)
steps.description: User clicks an external link. The engine checks for blockers (unload, Cache-Control: no-store).

steps.label: 2. Page Frozen in RAM
steps.description: The V8 heap, DOM tree, and scroll offset stay in memory with zero CPU consumption.

steps.label: 3. Back Navigation (pageshow)
steps.description: Instant restoration. load and DOMContentLoaded do NOT re-fire; only pageshow(persisted=true) runs.
